body_en: Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Western Sydney Airport (WSI) Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights
Western Sydney International Airport opened to passengers on Sunday, 25 October, with a sold-out Jetstar service to the Gold Coast marking its first commercial departure.

Flight JQ362 took off shortly before 11:30 local time, following the opening of check-in at 08:00. A return service from the Gold Coast was scheduled to arrive at 15:00, followed by the airport’s first Melbourne departure at 18:00.

Located at Badgerys Creek, approximately 45 kilometres from central Sydney, the airport operates around the clock, offering an alternative to the curfew-restricted Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport. Cargo operations began in July.

Chief executive Simon Hickey described the opening as a generational change for Australian aviation. The initial terminal can handle about ten million passengers a year, a level the airport expects to reach in the early to mid-2030s.

Longer-term development, including additional terminals and a second runway, could increase capacity to 82 million passengers a year in the 2060s. These figures represent potential future capacity rather than opening-year traffic forecasts.

Hickey said passengers could have access to more than 250 destinations through connecting airline networks within just over a year. That figure includes onward connections and does not represent the number of nonstop routes from Western Sydney.

Approximately 10,000 people worked on the airport’s construction, around half from Western Sydney. The airport estimates that up to 8,500 jobs will support operations across the precinct once annual passenger numbers reach ten million.

title_en: How Airbus' New Clean Sheet Freighter Challenges Boeing’s Dominance In The Cargo Sector
title_zh: 空中客车公司的新型货机如何挑战波音公司在货运领域的主导地位
summary: Airbus presses its advantage with composite-heavy A350F claiming 11% more volume and shared spares with A350 passenger fleet.
summary_zh: 空中客车公司凭借复合材料重型 A350F 扩大了其优势，声称体积增加了 11%，并与 A350 客机共享备件。
body_en: How Airbus' New Clean Sheet Freighter Challenges Boeing’s Dominance In The Cargo Sector
With a Master’s degree in Air Transport Management, Viviana brings her passion for aviation to Simple Flying, while specialising in managing Time-Critical Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations.

For decades, Boeing has dominated the large-freighter market, with its iconic 747 Freighter and highly successful 777F leaving Airbus struggling to establish a meaningful presence in the segment. Now, that dominance faces a serious challenge. The Airbus A350F has secured 115 orders, compared with 81 for Boeing's next-generation 777-8F , marking a significant turnaround for a manufacturer whose previous dedicated freighter struggled to attract customers. On September 29, the A350F completed its maiden flight, bringing Airbus one step closer to its target of certification and first deliveries in the second half of 2027.

With higher payload capacity than the current 777F, improved fuel efficiency, and a wider main-deck cargo door, the A350F promises cargo operators a compelling alternative. However, Boeing's established market position and the forthcoming 777-8F mean the battle is far from decided. Can Airbus turn its early commercial momentum into a lasting challenge to Boeing's freighter dominance?
Boeing Has Dominated Large Freighters For Decades

Boeing has dominated the widebody freighter market for decades, building its position with iconic aircraft such as the 747F, 767F, and 777F . While the 747 became synonymous with long-haul air cargo, the 777F established itself as a leading twin-engine freighter, offering operators a combination of payload capacity, range and operating efficiency. Together, these aircraft helped Boeing establish a strong presence among the world's largest cargo airlines.

Airbus, by contrast, has historically struggled to gain a foothold in the dedicated freighter market. Its previous offering, the A330-200F, secured just 38 orders, reflecting the difficulties of competing against Boeing's established product portfolio. One of Boeing's advantages is the large market for passenger-to-freighter (P2F) conversions . Aircraft such as the 767 and 747 have long been converted into freighters, letting operators gain cargo capacity without buying an entirely new aircraft. This is a massive advantage for airlines. By retaining much of the original airframe, engines, and avionics, conversions can offer a more affordable alternative to factory-built freighters, although they still require substantial structural modifications and certification.

However, Airbus is now finally taking a different approach. Rather than introducing another A330 derivative, the manufacturer has developed the A350F as a new-generation widebody freighter designed to compete directly with Boeing's largest twin-engine cargo aircraft. With advances in materials, fuel efficiency, and cargo-loading capabilities, Airbus hopes to challenge a market position Boeing has maintained for decades. But what makes the A350F different enough to succeed where its predecessor struggled?
The A350F Offers More Than Just Improved Fuel Efficiency

The A350F offers a maximum payload of 111 tonnes , exceeding the current 777F's 103.7 tonnes , with a range of approximately 8,700 kilometers at maximum payload. Its 4.3-meter-wide main-deck cargo door, which Airbus describes as the largest in its class, is designed to accommodate oversized shipments, including aircraft engines. The aircraft also features an optimized cargo floor layout, allowing greater flexibility in pallet positioning and weight distribution. According to Airbus, the A350F offers 11% more cargo volume than its comparator, giving operators more flexibility on long-haul freight routes.

Efficiency is another major selling point. Built using more than 70% advanced materials, including composites and titanium, the A350F benefits from a lighter structure, with Airbus citing a maximum take-off weight up to 46 tonnes lower than the current 777F. The manufacturer also claims that the aircraft can reduce fuel consumption and associated CO₂ emissions by up to 40% compared with older-generation freighters. Beyond fuel efficiency, the A350F benefits from its commonality with the established A350 passenger family, sharing 100% of engine spares and tooling, 99% of airframe tooling and 98% of spares. This could allow airlines already operating the A350 to streamline maintenance, reduce spare-parts inventories and minimize additional investment. Airbus is also targeting high operational reliability, drawing on the maturity of the existing A350 passenger fleet.

However, all these performance and efficiency figures remain manufacturer claims rather than independently verified results from commercial freighter operations. While the A350F's specifications suggest a potentially competitive alternative to Boeing's established freighters, its real-world performance will only become clear after entering service. For now, the more immediate question is whether airlines are sufficiently convinced by these promises to order the aircraft.

Airbus' growing order book suggests that airlines are increasingly willing to consider an alternative to Boeing's established freighter portfolio. By the end of August 2026, the A350F had accumulated 115 firm orders , including 34 secured during the first eight months of the year. This represents an increase of approximately 42% from the 81 orders recorded at the beginning of 2026. The aircraft has already surpassed the commercial performance of Airbus' previous purpose-built freighter, the A330-200F, which attracted just 38 orders throughout its production program. Meanwhile, Boeing had recorded 81 net orders for the competing 777-8F through July 2026, giving Airbus a 34-aircraft lead based on the available reporting figures.

Among the A350F's customers, Atlas Air stands out as particularly significant. The New York-based cargo operator, currently reliant on Boeing aircraft, ordered 20 A350Fs in March 2026, making it the type's largest customer. Deliveries are scheduled between 2029 and 2034, supporting the airline's long-term fleet expansion and the gradual retirement of its aging Boeing 747-400 freighters. Other customers include Air China Cargo, Etihad Airways, STARLUX Airlines, and AviLease, each ordering 10 aircraft. Interestingly, Azerbaijan's Silk Way West Airlines has committed to both manufacturers, ordering two A350Fs and two Boeing 777-8Fs, showing that some operators value access to both competing platforms.
body_zh: 空中客车公司的新型货机如何挑战波音公司在货运领域的主导地位
Viviana 拥有航空运输管理硕士学位，她将自己对航空的热情融入到 Simple Flying 中，同时专门负责管理时间紧迫的飞机地面 (AOG) 情况。

几十年来，波音一直主导着大型货机市场，其标志性的 747 货机和非常成功的 777F 使得空客在该领域难以建立有意义的存在。现在，这种主导地位面临着严峻的挑战。空客 A350F 已获得 115 架订单，而波音下一代 777-8F 则获得 81 架订单，这标志着这家以前的专用货机难以吸引客户的制造商实现了重大转变。 9月29日，A350F完成首飞，使空客距离2027年下半年获得认证和首次交付的目标又近了一步。
A350F 具有比当前 777F 更高的有效负载能力、更高的燃油效率以及更宽的主甲板货舱门，为货运运营商提供了一个引人注目的选择。然而，波音公司已确立的市场地位和即将推出的 777-8F 意味着这场战斗还远未结束。空客能否将其早期​​的商业势头转变为对波音货机主导地位的持久挑战？
波音几十年来一直主导大型货机
几十年来，波音一直主导着宽体货机市场，凭借 747F、767F 和 777F 等标志性飞机奠定了自己的地位。虽然 747 已成为长途航空货运的代名词，但 777F 已成为领先的双引擎货机，为运营商提供有效负载能力、航程和运营效率的结合。这些飞机共同帮助波音公司在全球最大的货运航空公司中建立了强大的影响力。

相比之下，空中客车公司历来一直难以在专用货机市场上站稳脚跟。其之前的产品 A330-200F 仅获得了 38 份订单，反映出与波音现有产品组合竞争的困难。波音公司的优势之一是客改货（P2F）的巨大市场。 767 和 747 等飞机长期以来一直被改装成货机，让运营商无需购买全新飞机即可获得货运能力。这对于航空公司来说是一个巨大的优势。通过保留大部分原始机身、发动机和航空电子设备，改装可以为工厂制造的货机提供更实惠的替代品，尽管它们仍然需要大量的结构修改和认证。
然而，空中客车公司现在终于采取了不同的方法。该制造商没有推出另一款 A330 衍生产品，而是将 A350F 开发为新一代宽体货机，旨在与波音最大的双引擎货机直接竞争。凭借在材料、燃油效率和货物装载能力方面的进步，空中客车公司希望挑战波音公司数十年来保持的市场地位。但是什么让 A350F 与众不同，能够在其前身苦苦挣扎的领域取得成功呢？
A350F 提供的不仅仅是更高的燃油效率
A350F 的最大有效载荷为 111 吨，超过当前 777F 的 103.7 吨，最大有效载荷航程约为 8,700 公里。其 4.3 米宽的主甲板货舱门被空中客车公司称为同类产品中最大的，旨在容纳超大型货物，包括飞机发动机。该飞机还具有优化的货舱地板布局，使托盘定位和重量分配具有更大的灵活性。据空客称，A350F 的货运量比同类机型高出 11%，为运营商在长途货运航线上提供了更大的灵活性。

效率是另一个主要卖点。 A350F 采用超过 70% 的先进材料制造，包括复合材料和钛合金，得益于更轻的结构，空中客车公司称其最大起飞重量比当前的 777F 减少了 46 吨。该制造商还声称，与老一代货机相比，该飞机可减少高达 40% 的燃油消耗和相关二氧化碳排放。除了燃油效率之外，A350F 还受益于其与成熟的 A350 客机系列的通用性，共享 100% 的发动机备件和工具、99% 的机身工具和 98% 的备件。这可以让已经运营 A350 的航空公司简化维护、减少备件库存并最大限度地减少额外投资。空中客车公司还利用现有 A350 客机的成熟度，瞄准高运行可靠性。
然而，所有这些性能和效率数据仍然是制造商声称的，而不是来自商业货机运营的独立验证结果。虽然 A350F 的规格表明它是波音现有货机的潜在竞争替代品，但其实际性能只有在投入使用后才会变得清晰。目前，更紧迫的问题是航空公司是否充分相信这些订购飞机的承诺。

空客不断增长的订单表明，航空公司越来越愿意考虑波音现有货机组合的替代方案。截至2026年8月，A350F已累计确认订单115架，其中34架是今年前8个月获得的。这比 2026 年初记录的 81 架订单增加了约 42%。该飞机已经超过了空客之前专用货机 A330-200F 的商业表现，后者在整个生产计划中仅吸引了 38 架订单。与此同时，截至 2026 年 7 月，波音已录得 81 架 777-8F 净订单，根据现有报告数据，空客在 34 架飞机上处于领先地位。

在 A350F 的客户中，阿特拉斯航空尤为重要。这家总部位于纽约的货运运营商目前依赖波音飞机，于 2026 年 3 月订购了 20 架 A350F，成为该机型的最大客户。交付计划于 2029 年至 2034 年之间进行，以支持该航空公司的长期机队扩张以及老化的波音 747-400 货机的逐步退役。其他客户包括国货航、阿提哈德航空、星宇航空和 AviLease，各订购了 10 架飞机。有趣的是，阿塞拜疆丝绸之路西部航空公司已向两家制造商做出承诺，订购了两架 A350F 和两架波音 777-8F，这表明一些运营商重视使用这两个竞争平台。

title_en: Why WestJet Is Sending Boeing 737 MAX 8 Recliners Across The Atlantic While American & JetBlue Bet On Lie-Flats
title_zh: 为什么西捷航空将波音 737 MAX 8 躺椅运送到大西洋彼岸，而美国航空和捷蓝航空则押注于平躺式躺椅
summary: American Airlines and JetBlue dedicate far more seating to premium passengers on long-and-thin routes.
summary_zh: 美国航空和捷蓝航空在细长的航线上为高级乘客提供了更多的座位。
body_en: Why WestJet Is Sending Boeing 737 MAX 8 Recliners Across The Atlantic While American & JetBlue Bet On Lie-Flats

Based in the UK, Josh is a keen writer with a degree in Military History. Having worked previously as a financial journalist, he has covered the aviation industry extensively, reporting on airlines' results and monthly passenger statistics in the aftermath of the pandemic, alongside the likes of regulation around sustainable fuels, and the prospects for hydrogen-powered commercial flight. He joins Simple Flying with a lifelong love of all things aviation.

WestJet offers a prime example of where the Boeing 737 MAX 8 is used to serve a similar purpose to the larger and longer-range Airbus A321LR or Airbus A321XLR . Over the past summer, the Canadian-based carrier has ramped up its transatlantic offerings using the 737 MAX 8. This has placed it as the second-largest narrowbody transatlantic operator behind only Icelandair .

But WestJet has stuck with a full cabin of recline-only seats on its 737 MAX 8s for such flights. In contrast, the likes of American Airlines and JetBlue offer a number of lie-flat options on similar routes flown by Airbus narrowbodies between North America and Europe. While each example reflects different ways of approaching the same market, standing by all-recliner-style seating offers WestJet a range of other benefits.
WestJet Does Offer Some Premium Seats On 737 MAX 8s

WestJet does actually offer several fare options for passengers flying on its 737 MAX 8s, so it is far from a case of a one-size-fits-all solution aboard its narrowbody transatlantic services. This does look different to some peers’ offerings within the same market, however.

With 69 narrowbodies in its mainline fleet, WestJet’s 737 MAX 8s come in one of two slightly different configurations. All offer 174 seats, 12 of which are labeled as Premium by the airline and are laid out 2-2 across the first three rows of the aircraft. In terms of economy seating, WestJet offers either 36 or 24 so-called Extended Comfort options depending on the specific aircraft. Passengers can also choose between Preferred and Standard Economy seats, with the former simply located farther forward in the cabin and retaining the same specifications as the most basic option.

Premium seats aboard all of WestJet’s 737 MAX 8s measure 38 inches (96.5 cm) in pitch, 21.3 inches (54.3 cm) in width, and can recline up to five inches (12.7 cm). Preferred and Standard Economy options come in at 30 inches (76.2 cm) and 16.3 to 17.3 inches (41.4 to 43.9 cm) in pitch and width, respectively, while Extended Comfort narrows the gap between the cheapest and most luxurious offerings. All told, that means WestJet’s 737 MAX 8s carry three distinct seat types without sacrificing too much room in favor of one cabin over another. This is arguably necessary given how the carrier uses the aircraft.
WestJet Moves Further Into European Market Using 737 MAX 8

In recent months, WestJet has moved further into the European market by launching eight new nonstop routes . Originating from four airports in Canada and serving seven airports across the Atlantic, these are all operated exclusively by 737 MAX 8s, which themselves make up a large proportion of WestJet’s fleet.

Specifically, the new routes include: Three connections from Halifax / Stanfield International Airport (YHZ) to Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS), Adolfo Suárez Madrid Barajas Airport (MAD), and Copenhagen Kastrup Airport (CPH); three between Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) and Glasgow Airport (GLA), Ponta Delgada Airport (PDL) in the Azores, as well as Cardiff Airport (CWL); one from Edmonton International Airport (YEG) to Reykjavík Keflavík International Airport (KEF); and another between Winnipeg / James Armstrong Richardson International Airport (YWG) and Reykjavík.

That meant WestJet buoyed its European network by 44% year-on-year with a single aircraft variant. Naturally, its 737 MAX 8s also serve a string of other routes and form the backbone of its fleet. Conversely, American Airlines and JetBlue have opted for more specialized planes on comparable long-and-thin routes, like those new to WestJet.
American Airlines And JetBlue Use Specialized Variants For Similar Purpose

These include variants from the Airbus A321neo family specifically developed for the purpose of pushing the bounds of narrowbody flight. Where long-haul connections like those between North America and Europe were historically opened up by widebodies, the larger models had to be filled to make flights viable for airlines. New single-aisle jets, such as Airbus’ longer-range A321neo variants, have in turn opened the door for airlines to serve less dense but still lengthy routes where this may have been the case.

At US-based JetBlue, transatlantic operations have been built around the A321LR since it entered the market in 2021. Though it has plans to eventually introduce the A321XLR as well, the bulk of its transatlantic services are flown by the 11 A321LRs within its fleet as it stands. These encompass 138 seats in total , 24 of which are in the form of Mint suites with lie-flat beds.

Similarly, American Airlines is in the process of adding the A321XLR to its fleet, in part to open long-and-thin connections to and from Europe. The first of these began this year, linking John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and Edinburgh Airport (EDI). Unlike JetBlue, American Airlines’ introduction of the long-range single-aisle variant complements an extensive widebody fleet. The common factor is that American Airlines uses such aircraft for a similar, specific purpose and offers 20 lie-flat Flagship Suites out of 155 seats onboard . Needless to say, this means there is a disparity in the way the two approach the market against WestJet.
Cost Versus Comfort On Long And Thin Transatlantic Routes

Indeed, JetBlue and American Airlines both reserve far more space for premium-paying passengers aboard their long-range single-aisle variants. For American Airlines, lie-flat seats make up almost 13% of its A321XLRs’ total capacity. In terms of JetBlue’s A321LRs, that proportion exceeds 21%. That is before factoring in the mix of premium economy and economy extra equivalents on each.

Aboard American Airlines’ A321XLRs, for example, passengers will also find 12 Premium Economy seats with 38 inches (96.5 cm) of pitch and 21.3 inches (54.1 cm) in width. A further 12 Main Cabin Extra options measuring 34 inches (86.4 cm) and 16.6 to 18.7 inches (42.2 to 47.5 cm) in pitch and width, respectively, are also offered as an alternative to standard Main Cabin seats. These themselves exceed WestJet’s own standard offerings by two inches (5.1 cm) in pitch. For reference, some of JetBlue’s 24 EvenMore premium economy seats also bridge the gap between standard and lie-flat on its A321LRs.
body_zh: 为什么西捷航空将波音 737 MAX 8 躺椅运送到大西洋彼岸，而美国航空和捷蓝航空则押注于平躺式躺椅
乔什居住在英国，是一位热心作家，拥有军事史学位。此前，他曾担任财经记者，广泛报道了航空业，报道了疫情后航空公司的业绩和每月乘客统计数据，以及可持续燃料的监管以及氢动力商业航班的前景等。他带着对航空一切事物的终生热爱加入了 Simple Flying。
西捷航空提供了一个典型的例子，说明波音 737 MAX 8 的用途与更大、航程更长的空客 A321LR 或空客 A321XLR 类似。去年夏天，这家总部位于加拿大的航空公司使用 737 MAX 8 扩大了其跨大西洋航线。这使其成为仅次于冰岛航空的第二大窄体跨大西洋航空公司。
但西捷航空在其 737 MAX 8 上坚持在此类航班上保留全机舱只能倾斜的座位。相比之下，美国航空和捷蓝航空等航空公司在空客窄体飞机往返于北美和欧洲之间的类似航线上提供了多种平躺选择。虽然每个例子都反映了进入同一市场的不同方式，但采用全躺椅式座椅为西捷航空提供了一系列其他好处。
西捷航空在 737 MAX 8 上提供一些高级座位
实际上，西捷航空确实为乘坐 737 MAX 8 飞机的乘客提供了多种票价选择，因此在其窄体跨大西洋服务上，它远非一种通用的解决方案。然而，这与同一市场中一些同行的产品看起来确实有所不同。

西捷航空的干线机队拥有 69 架窄体客机，其 737 MAX 8 飞机采用两种略有不同的配置之一。所有飞机均提供 174 个座位，其中 12 个被航空公司标记为高级座位，并以 2-2 的方式分布在飞机的前三排。在经济舱座位方面，西捷航空根据具体飞机提供 36 或 24 个所谓的“扩展舒适”座位选项。乘客还可以选择首选经济舱座位和标准经济舱座位，前者只是位于机舱更靠前的位置，并保留与最基本选项相同的规格。

西捷航空所有 737 MAX 8 上的高级座椅间距为 38 英寸（96.5 厘米），宽度为 21.3 英寸（54.3 厘米），最大可倾斜 5 英寸（12.7 厘米）。首选经济舱和标准经济舱的间距和宽度分别为 30 英寸（76.2 厘米）和 16.3 至 17.3 英寸（41.4 至 43.9 厘米），而扩展舒适舱则缩小了最便宜和最豪华产品之间的差距。总而言之，这意味着西捷航空的 737 MAX 8 飞机可搭载三种不同的座位类型，而不会因一个客舱而牺牲太多空间。考虑到航母如何使用飞机，这可以说是必要的。
西捷航空使用 737 MAX 8 进一步进军欧洲市场
近几个月来，西捷航空进一步进军欧洲市场，推出了 8 条新的直达航线。这些航班从加拿大的四个机场出发，服务于大西洋彼岸的七个机场，全部由 737 MAX 8 客机运营，而这些飞机本身在西捷航空机队中占很大比例。

具体来说，新航线包括：从哈利法克斯/斯坦菲尔德国际机场（YHZ）飞往里斯本温贝托·德尔加多机场（LIS）、阿道弗·苏亚雷斯·马德里·巴拉哈斯机场（MAD）和哥本哈根卡斯特鲁普机场（CPH）的3条航线；多伦多皮尔逊国际机场 (YYZ) 和格拉斯哥机场 (GLA)、亚速尔群岛的蓬塔德尔加达机场 (PDL) 以及卡迪夫机场 (CWL) 之间有 3 个航班；一班从埃德蒙顿国际机场 (YEG) 飞往雷克雅未克凯夫拉维克国际机场 (KEF)；另一个往返于温尼伯/詹姆斯·阿姆斯特朗·理查森国际机场 (YWG) 和雷克雅未克之间。
这意味着西捷航空凭借单一机型将其欧洲网络同比增长了 44%。当然，其 737 MAX 8 还提供一系列其他航线，并构成其机队的骨干力量。相反，美国航空和捷蓝航空在类似的长而细的航线上选择了更专业的飞机，就像西捷航空的新航线一样。
美国航空和捷蓝航空使用专门的变体来实现类似目的
其中包括专门为突破窄体飞行界限而开发的空客 A321neo 系列的变体。历史上，像北美和欧洲之间的长途航线都是由宽体飞机开辟的，因此必须配备更大的型号才能使航空公司的航班可行。新型单通道喷气式飞机，例如空中客车公司的远程 A321neo 型号，反过来又为航空公司提供服务密度较低但仍然漫长的航线打开了大门。
总部位于美国的捷蓝航空，自 2021 年 A321LR 进入市场以来，一直围绕 A321LR 开展跨大西洋业务。尽管该公司计划最终也推出 A321XLR，但其大部分跨大西洋服务均由其机队中的 11 架 A321LR 执飞。共有 138 个座位，其中 24 个为 Mint 套房，配有平躺床。

同样，美国航空正在将 A321XLR 添加到其机队中，部分原因是为了开通往返欧洲的长而细的航线。其中第一个项目于今年开始，连接约翰·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 和爱丁堡机场 (EDI)。与捷蓝航空不同，美国航空推出的远程单通道机型补充了广泛的宽体机队。共同点是美国航空将此类飞机用于类似的特定目的，并在机上 155 个座位​​中提供 20 个平躺式旗舰套房。不用说，这意味着两家公司针对西捷航空进入市场的方式存在差异。
又长又窄的跨大西洋航线的成本与舒适度
事实上，捷蓝航空和美国航空都在其远程单通道飞机上为付费乘客预留了更多的空间。对于美国航空来说，平躺式座椅几乎占其 A321XLR 总运力的 13%。就捷蓝航空的A321LR而言，这一比例超过了21%。这是在将高级经济舱和经济舱额外等价物的组合考虑在内之前的情况。

例如，在美国航空的 A321XLR 飞机上，乘客还可以找到 12 个豪华经济舱座椅，座椅间距为 38 英寸（96.5 厘米），宽度为 21.3 英寸（54.1 厘米）。此外，还提供另外 12 个主舱额外选项，间距和宽度分别为 34 英寸（86.4 厘米）和 16.6 至 18.7 英寸（42.2 至 47.5 厘米），作为标准主舱座椅的替代方案。这些本身的间距超出了西捷航空自己的标准产品两英寸（5.1 厘米）。作为参考，捷蓝航空的 24 个 EvenMore 高级经济舱座位中的一些也弥补了 A321LR 上标准座位和平躺座位之间的差距。

title_en: How Much Does It Really Cost To Own A Small Plane In 2026?
title_zh: 2026 年拥有一架小型飞机到底要花多少钱？
summary: Owning a small plane in 2026 may cost more than the purchase price. Here's what drives the real expense of flying a Cessna 172.
summary_zh: 到 2026 年，拥有一架小型飞机的成本可能会超过购买价格。以下是驾驶塞斯纳 172 的实际费用的驱动因素。
body_en: Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

A used Cessna 172 Skyhawk can cost about as much as a high-end SUV. The purchase price, however, is the easiest number to find. The harder question is how much cash you need to keep the airplane flying year after year, especially when an annual inspection uncovers work that was not in the budget.

For a Cessna 172 flown about 100 hours a year, a reasonable starting budget is another substantial sum that approaches the price of a utility car, but there are lots of factors to keep in mind that will affect the costs. In our article, we will break down the purchase price, the recurring expenses and the costs that are easy to overlook. The figures focus on the Cessna 172, and the price may vary for similar aircraft in the same GA category.
How Much Does It Cost To Own A Small Plane In 2026?

Most 2026 estimates put annual ownership of a Cessna 172 at about $20,000 to $35,000 for roughly 100 hours of flying, before loan payments, according to Rotate's 2026 aircraft ownership guide . That is a broad range, and for good reason: hangar costs, pilot experience and maintenance history can change the bill substantially. That works out to $200 to $350 per flight hour. The lower end may look manageable next to the cost of buying the airplane, but the hourly figure changes sharply if you fly less than planned. A substantial part of the bill arrives whether the aircraft flies or sits in the hangar.

The purchase itself is a major expense. Jaken Aviation's 2026 cost breakdown puts a flyable 1970s-era 172 at about $90,000 to $140,000, with a newer, cleaner example reaching roughly $180,000. There are cheaper ways to get into general aviation. As reported by Jettly , older two-seat Cessna 150s and Cessna 152 s can sell for about $25,000 to $45,000, while a four-seat Piper PA-28 Cherokee may cost roughly $30,000 to $60,000. Those prices are not guarantees of a bargain: BlackJet describes the 2025-2026 used 172 market as tight, and an inexpensive aircraft can need expensive work.

Older estimates also help explain why published totals differ. A 2023-era Simple Flying breakdown of owning a single-engine Cessna put the cost of flying a Cessna 172R for 100 hours at about $30,000 a year, using $5,000 in fixed costs plus $200 per flight hour , based on the Aircraft Cost Calculator. The example in this article uses a higher fixed-cost allowance, particularly for the hangar and annual inspection. The lesson is not that one estimate must be wrong; it is that the assumptions matter. To see where the money goes, start with the costs that arrive before the engine even starts.
What Factors Influence The Cost Of Owning A Plane?

Aircraft ownership costs fall into three groups: fixed expenses, costs that increase with flying time, and reserves for major work later. AOPA's guide to budgeting for aircraft ownership makes the same distinction. Insurance depends in part on the pilot 's experience and recent time in type, while fuel and much of the routine maintenance rise with use. Fixed expenses, meanwhile, have to be covered whether you fly 20 hours or 200.

Hangar rent alone can run from about $300 a month at a small rural airport to more than $1,200 near a major city. That is $3,600 to over $14,400 a year before the aircraft has flown a minute. Insurance for a 172 commonly falls around $1,500 to $2,500 a year, although low-time pilots and more expensive aircraft can cost more to insure.

The annual inspection is another bill worth treating cautiously. The inspection fee is not necessarily the final price. E3 Aviation Association estimates $1,500 to $2,200 for the inspection itself, but says a typical total with repairs can reach $2,500 to $4,500. On a neglected airplane, the bill may climb to $8,000 to $12,000. That is why buying a plane with a lower asking price does not automatically make it cheaper to own.

Fuel is one of the largest costs tied directly to flying. A Cessna 172 burns roughly 8 to 9 gallons (30 to 34 liters) an hour. At assumed 2026 Avgas prices of $6.50 to $8.50 per gallon ($1.72 to $2.25 per liter), 100 hours of flying would mean about $5,200 to $7,700 in fuel alone.

In this example, fixed costs account for $12,300 of the annual total, while the variable items add about $96 per flight hour. At 100 hours, the result is roughly $219 an hour. At 50 hours, the same budget rises to about $342 per hour; at 200 hours, it falls to around $157. One 2026 estimate puts a 172 at about $440 an hour at 75 hours a year and $190 an hour at 200 hours. The aircraft has not changed. The number of hours spread across the fixed bills has. Of course, hangar, insurance and maintenance history could move the total in either direction. And the annual inspection is not the only cost that can keep a new owner out: experienced owners also have to set money aside for work that may be years away.
What Do Experts And Aviation Sources Say About Ownership Costs?

The recurring warning from aviation publications is to budget for future repairs, not just the bills that arrive this year. In Flying Magazine , AOPA highlights the importance of setting aside money for engine, propeller, avionics and airframe overhauls. The article estimates annual costs of $15,000 to $35,000 for a single-engine piston aircraft flown 100 hours, excluding loan payments.

An owner's current records show why estimates can vary so widely. In an AOPA Pilot column , airline pilot Chip Wright tracked nearly $196,000 in spending on his 1977 Piper Arrow during the first two years, including the purchase and upgrades. His shop quoted $2,700 for an annual inspection, but a mechanic encountering the airplane for the first time needed additional hours to review the logbooks. Wright's direct operating costs came to about $80 to $90 per flight hour for fuel and oil, plus $520 a month for hangar and insurance.

Simple Flying's ownership guide to the Skyhawk also notes that buyers often underestimate operating costs and that insurance depends on both the pilot's experience and the aircraft's value. The guide lists 2,000 flying hours as the maximum recommended interval between engine overhauls. For an owner flying 100 hours a year, that interval could represent 20 years of flying, but a used aircraft's engine may already have accumulated much of that time.

Before comparing aircraft, check which expenses each estimate includes and whether it reflects the airport where you intend to keep the plane. The cheapest figure on paper may leave out the reserve that makes the difference between a manageable annual bill and an expensive surprise. It is also worth asking whether the 172 is the right aircraft for your needs in the first place.
body_zh: 安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。
一架二手塞斯纳 172 Skyhawk 的价格与一辆高端 SUV 相当。然而，购买价格是最容易找到的数字。更难的问题是，你需要多少现金才能让飞机年复一年地飞行，特别是当年度检查发现预算之外的工作时。
对于每年飞行约 100 小时的塞斯纳 172 来说，合理的起始预算是另一笔相当大的金额，接近一辆多功能车的价格，但需要记住许多因素会影响成本。在我们的文章中，我们将详细分析购买价格、经常性费用和容易被忽视的成本。这些数据主要针对塞斯纳 172，同一 GA 类别中的类似飞机的价格可能会有所不同。
2026 年拥有一架小型飞机需要多少钱？

根据 Rotate 的 2026 年飞机所有权指南，大多数人预计 2026 年塞斯纳 172 的年所有权价格约为 20,000 至 35,000 美元，飞行约 100 小时（在贷款支付之前）。这是一个广泛的范围，并且有充分的理由：机库成本、飞行员经验和维护历史可以大大改变账单。每飞行小时相当于 200 至 350 美元。与购买飞机的成本相比，较低的价格看起来可能是可控的，但如果您的飞行时间少于计划，每小时的数字就会急剧变化。无论飞机在飞行还是停在机库中，账单的很大一部分都会到达。

购买本身就是一项重大开支。 Jaken Aviation 的 2026 年成本明细显示，一架可飞行的 1970 年代 172 的价格约为 90,000 至 140,000 美元，而更新、更清洁的型号则达到约 180,000 美元。有更便宜的方法可以进入通用航空领域。据 Jetly 报道，老式两座塞斯纳 150 和塞斯纳 152 的售价约为 25,000 至 45,000 美元，而四座 Piper PA-28 切诺基可能售价约为 30,000 至 60,000 美元。这些价格并不能保证便宜：BlackJet 将 2025-2026 年二手 172 市场描述为紧张，一架便宜的飞机可能需要昂贵的工作。

较早的估计也有助于解释为什么公布的总数有所不同。根据飞机成本计算器，2023 年简单飞行对拥有一架单引擎塞斯纳飞机的分析显示，使用塞斯纳 172R 飞行 100 小时的成本每年约为 30,000 美元，其中固定成本为 5,000 美元，加上每飞行小时 200 美元。本文中的示例使用了较高的固定成本津贴，特别是机库和年检。这个教训并不是说某个估计一定是错误的；而是说一个估计一定是错误的。重要的是假设。要了解资金的去向，请从发动机启动之前产生的成本开始。
哪些因素影响拥有飞机的成本？
飞机拥有成本分为三类：固定费用、随飞行时间增加的成本以及后期主要工作的储备。 AOPA 的飞机拥有预算指南也做出了同样的区分。保险部分取决于飞行员的经验和最近使用该型号的时间，而燃料和大部分日常维护费用会随着使用而增加。与此同时，无论您飞行 20 小时还是 200 小时，都必须支付固定费用。
仅机库租金一项就可以从小型乡村机场的每月约 300 美元到大城市附近的每月 1,200 多美元不等。飞机起飞一分钟之前，每年的费用为 3,600 美元至 14,400 美元以上。 172 型飞机的保险每年通常在 1,500 至 2,500 美元左右，尽管低频率飞行员和更昂贵的飞机的保险费用可能更高。
年检是另一项值得谨慎对待的法案。检查费不一定是最终价格。 E3 航空协会估计检查本身的费用为 1,500 至 2,200 美元，但表示维修费用通常可达 2,500 至 4,500 美元。对于一架被忽视的飞机，账单可能会攀升至 8,000 至 12,000 美元。这就是为什么以较低的要价购买飞机并不意味着拥有它会更便宜。
燃油是与飞行直接相关的最大成本之一。塞斯纳 172 每小时大约燃烧 8 至 9 加仑（30 至 34 升）。假设 2026 年航空汽油价格为每加仑 6.50 美元至 8.50 美元（每升 1.72 美元至 2.25 美元），飞行 100 小时就意味着仅燃油费用就约为 5,200 至 7,700 美元。

在此示例中，固定成本占年度总额的 12,300 美元，而可变项目每飞行小时增加约 96 美元。按 100 小时计算，每小时的费用约为 219 美元。 50 小时后，同样的预算将升至每小时 342 美元左右； 200 小时后，价格降至 157 美元左右。据估计，到 2026 年，172 每年工作 75 小时的费用约为每小时 440 美元，每年工作 200 小时的费用约为每小时 190 美元。飞机没有改变。固定账单上分布的小时数。当然，机库、保险和维护历史可能会使总数朝任一方向移动。年度检查并不是让新业主望而却步的唯一费用：经验丰富的业主还必须为可能需要数年后的工作预留资金。
专家和航空界人士对拥有成本有何看法？
航空出版物反复警告说，要为未来的维修制定预算，而不仅仅是今年的账单。在《飞行杂志》中，AOPA 强调了为发动机、螺旋桨、航空电子设备和机身大修预留资金的重要性。该文章估计，一架单引擎活塞飞机飞行 100 小时的年成本为 15,000 至 35,000 美元，不包括贷款付款。

业主当前的记录表明了为什么估算结果会有如此大的差异。在 AOPA Pilot 专栏中，航空公司飞行员 Chip Wright 记录了他的 1977 Piper Arrow 飞机头两年的花费近 196,000 美元，包括购买和升级。他的工厂报价为 2,700 美元进行年度检查，但第一次接触这架飞机的机械师需要额外的时间来查看日志。赖特的直接运营成本约为每飞行小时 80 至 90 美元的燃油和燃油，加上每月 520 美元的机库和保险费用。
Simple Flying 的 Skyhawk 拥有指南还指出，购买者经常低估运营成本，并且保险取决于飞行员的经验和飞机的价值。该指南列出了 2,000 飞行小时作为发动机大修的最大建议间隔时间。对于每年飞行 100 小时的机主来说，这个间隔可能代表 20 年的飞行时间，但二手飞机的发动机可能已经积累了大部分时间。
在比较飞机之前，请检查每个估算包括哪些费用以及它是否反映了您打算停飞飞机的机场。纸面上最便宜的数字可能会忽略储备金，而储备金是可控年度账单和昂贵意外之间的区别。还值得一问的是 172 是否是适合您需求的飞机。

title_en: Caught On Camera: Jet2 Boeing 737-800 Veers Off Runway At Birmingham Airport
title_zh: 摄像机捕捉到：Jet2 波音 737-800 在伯明翰机场偏离跑道
summary: It happened as Storm Boelo brought strong winds to the UK.
summary_zh: 事情发生时，风暴博埃洛给英国带来了强风。
body_en: Caught On Camera: Jet2 Boeing 737-800 Veers Off Runway At Birmingham Airport

Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

A Boeing 737-800 operated by Jet2 veered off the runway at Birmingham International Airport (BHX) on Sunday. The hard landing, now circulating on social media, occurred as unsettled weather associated with Storm Boelo brought strong winds across parts of the country, raising questions about the conditions pilots faced during landing. According to the BBC , the aircraft, from Venice Marco Polo International Airport (VCE), exited the runway after landing on Sunday afternoon due to "exceptional weather conditions" caused by the storm.

BHX is one of the UK's major international gateways, handling domestic services and flights to destinations across Europe. Jet2 operates a substantial 737 fleet , using the narrowbody aircraft on its leisure-focused network. Although modern commercial aircraft are designed to operate in challenging weather, strong, variable winds can complicate approaches and landings, especially when crosswinds affect an aircraft's alignment with the runway.
Jet2 Boeing 737-800 Runway Excursion: Strong Winds Hit Birmingham Airport

The plane veered onto the grass amid strong winds associated with Storm Boelo. It was operating LS1310, with the landing reported at approximately 14:19 local time on Runway 33. Turbine Traveller shared footage of the landing.

Weather observations from BHX indicate strong westerly winds earlier today. The 10:50 UTC METAR recorded winds from 270° at 18 knots, gusting to 29 knots, with the direction varying between 240° and 320°. The accompanying TAF, issued at 11:19 AM UTC, forecast winds from 270° at 18 knots, gusting to 35 knots, with temporary gusts potentially reaching 45 knots between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM UTC. These conditions matter because Runway 33 is oriented approximately northwest, so west winds can create a crosswind component during landing. Winds gusting over 32 knots (37 mph / 59 km/h) can complicate aircraft alignment during touchdown.

Storm Boelo brought particularly strong winds to northern parts of the UK, while the Met Office forecast that windy conditions would persist across the West Midlands. BHX's forecast indicated gusts reaching around 42 mph (68 km/h) during the afternoon.
The Jet2 spokesperson confirmed the complex landing conditions at BHX to BBC News.
"Flight LS1310 from Venice to Birmingham temporarily moved off the runway after landing at Birmingham Airport earlier this afternoon, due to exceptional weather conditions caused by Storm Boelo."

Storm Boelo brought unsettled weather to the UK over the weekend. According to the Met Office , the strongest winds were expected across Scotland, Northern Ireland and northern England, with gusts of 60-70 mph (97–113 km/h) and potentially 80 mph (129 km/h) in exposed locations. Birmingham, in the West Midlands, also experienced windy conditions, although the storm's strongest impacts were forecast farther north.

The storm's passage across the country created the potential for disruption to several forms of transport, including aviation. Strong winds can affect aircraft approaches, increase turbulence, and make ground handling more challenging, while heavy rain can reduce visibility and complicate airport operations.
How Winds Affect Airport Operations and Flights

Wind is a key consideration during every aircraft landing. Crosswinds can push an aircraft sideways relative to the runway , requiring pilots to make corrections to maintain the appropriate alignment. Gusts and sudden changes in wind speed can make those corrections more demanding, particularly during the final approach and touchdown. Pilots must operate within aircraft-specific crosswind limitations and consider the prevailing runway conditions.

Airports can respond to adverse weather by changing runway configurations, adjusting arrival rates, delaying departures, or diverting flights when conditions warrant it. Ground crews may also need to take extra precautions during strong winds. Simple Flying previously explored how weather affects aviation through several interconnected factors, including wind, visibility, precipitation, and runway conditions.

The video provides a visual record, but determining the cause requires evidence from operational records and weather observations. Until more details emerge, the incident reminds us of the challenges unsettled autumn weather can pose to commercial aviation.

body_zh: 摄像机捕捉到：Jet2 波音 737-800 在伯明翰机场偏离跑道
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
周日，一架由 Jet2 运营的波音 737-800 在伯明翰国际机场 (BHX) 冲出跑道。这次硬着陆现在在社交媒体上流传，其发生是因为与风暴博埃洛相关的不稳定天气给该国部分地区带来了强风，引发了人们对飞行员在着陆过程中面临的条件的质疑。据英国广播公司报道，由于风暴造成的“特殊天气条件”，这架从威尼斯马可波罗国际机场（VCE）起飞的飞机于周日下午着陆后退出跑道。
BHX 是英国主要的国际门户之一，负责处理国内服务和飞往欧洲各地目的地的航班。 Jet2 运营着一支庞大的 737 机队，在其以休闲为主的网络上使用窄体飞机。尽管现代商用飞机被设计为在恶劣的天气下运行，但强而多变的风会使进场和着陆变得复杂，特别是当侧风影响飞机与跑道的对齐时。
Jet2 波音 737-800 冲出跑道：强风袭击伯明翰机场
飞机在博埃洛风暴带来的强风中转向草地。该机运行的是 LS1310，据报道于当地时间 14 点 19 分左右在 33 号跑道着陆。Turbine Traveler 分享了着陆的镜头。

BHX 的天气观测表明今天早些时候有强西风。 UTC 10:50 METAR 记录的风速为 270°，风速为 18 节，阵风风速为 29 节，风向在 240° 至 320° 之间变化。随附的 TAF 于世界标准时间上午 11:19 发布，预报风速为 270 度，风速为 18 节，阵风可达 35 节，在世界标准时间中午 12:00 至下午 3:00 之间，暂时阵风可能达到 45 节。这些条件很重要，因为 33 号跑道大致面向西北方向，因此西风会在着陆过程中产生侧风分量。超过 32 节（37 英里/小时/59 公里/小时）的阵风会使飞机在着陆期间的对准变得复杂。
风暴博埃洛给英国北部地区带来了特别强的风，而英国气象局预测，西米德兰兹郡将持续大风。 BHX 的预报显示，下午阵风速度达到约 42 英里/小时（68 公里/小时）。
Jet2 发言人向 BBC 新闻证实了 BHX 的复杂着陆条件。
“由于风暴博埃洛造成的特殊天气状况，从威尼斯飞往伯明翰的 LS1310 航班今天下午早些时候在伯明翰机场降落后暂时脱离跑道。”
周末，风暴博埃洛给英国带来了不稳定的天气。据英国气象局称，预计苏格兰、北爱尔兰和英格兰北部将出现最强风，阵风速度为 60-70 英里/小时（97-113 公里/小时），在暴露地点可能达到 80 英里/小时（129 公里/小时）。西米德兰兹郡的伯明翰也经历了大风天气，不过预计风暴最严重的影响会在更北的地方。
风暴席卷全国，可能对包括航空在内的多种交通方式造成干扰。强风会影响飞机进场，增加湍流，并使地面处理更具挑战性，而大雨会降低能见度并使机场运营复杂化。
风如何影响机场运营和航班
风是每次飞机着陆时的一个关键考虑因素。侧风会将飞机推向跑道相对的一侧，要求飞行员进行修正以保持适当的对准。阵风和风速的突然变化可能会使这些修正变得更加困难，特别是在最后进近和着陆期间。飞行员必须在飞机特定的侧风限制内操作，并考虑当前的跑道条件。
机场可以通过改变跑道配置、调整到达率、延迟起飞或在条件允许时改道航班来应对恶劣天气。在强风期间，地勤人员可能还需要采取额外的预防措施。 Simple Flying 之前探索了天气如何通过几个相互关联的因素影响航空，包括风、能见度、降水和跑道条件。
视频提供了视觉记录，但确定原因需要来自操作记录和天气观测的证据。在更多细节浮出水面之前，这一事件提醒我们不稳定的秋季天气可能给商业航空带来的挑战。

title_en: My Current Credit Card Portfolio: 26 Cards, $7,979 In Annual Fees (Ouch!)
title_zh: 我当前的信用卡组合：26 张卡，年费 7,979 美元（哎呀！）
summary: I currently have 26 credit cards open. Here's every card in my wallet, its annual fee, why I keep it, and which ones I plan to cancel.
summary_zh: 我目前有 26 张信用卡。这是我钱包中的每张卡、其年费、我保留它的原因以及我计划取消哪些卡。
body_en: It goes without saying that some of us take maximizing credit card rewards to the extreme, and that can include holding onto a lot of credit cards. In this post, I’d like to lay my cards on the table… no pun intended!

After all, maximizing credit cards is one of the best ways to elevate your travel. This can include getting the credit cards with the best welcome bonuses , maximizing your return on spending , and taking advantage of credit card perks .

There are a lot of misconceptions about the impact that applying for credit cards can have on your credit score. So I’d like to first address how applying for credit cards impacts your credit score (I have lots of cards, and my score is excellent), then I’ll talk about what goes into my credit card decision making process, and then I’ll share the cards I currently have open.

There are a lot of misconceptions about how credit scores work, in particular people thinking that applying for credit cards hurts your credit score . That’s generally not true, and in many cases applying for cards can even help your credit score in the long run.
For context, I have a lot of credit cards, and my credit score is almost perfect , in the top couple percent nationwide.
For those of you not familiar, here’s what factors into your credit score
35% of your score is your payment history (the percentage of payments you’ve made on-time)
30% of your score is your credit utilization (how much credit you’re using compared to your total limits)
15% of your score is your credit age (the average age of your open accounts)
10% of your score is the types of credit you use (how many different types of requests for credit you have)
10% of your score is your requests for new credit (how many times you’ve applied for credit)

What’s most important is that you pay your bills on time, don’t utilize too much of your credit (meaning you want to ideally use 20% or less of your total available credit, and/or pay your credit card bills early ), and keep some cards long term, which will help increase your average age of accounts.

The only metric that’s lowered by applying for cards is your requests for new credit, but that makes up just 10% of your score. Furthermore, credit inquiries typically fall off your report after 24 months.
Closing credit cards that are no longer working for you potentially doesn’t harm your credit much either, though alternatively you can also often downgrade credit cards instead .
What I look for when applying for credit cards
For me, there are three things I look for when applying for credit cards
Credit cards that offer a big welcome bonus — often the introductory bonuses on cards are compelling, and enough reason to pick up a new card

Credit cards that offer a generous return on spending — there are some cards you have because they help you maximize the points you earn , whether it’s for everyday spending, for specific spending categories , or for large purchases

Credit cards that offer perks that more than justify the annual fee — some cards are worth holding onto even if you don’t plan on putting much spending on them, because they offer things like elite status , annual free nights , etc.

body_zh: 不言而喻，我们中的一些人将信用卡奖励最大化发挥到了极致，这可能包括持有大量信用卡。在这篇文章中，我想摊开我的牌……没有双关语的意思！
毕竟，充分利用信用卡是提升旅行体验的最佳方式之一。这可以包括获得具有最佳欢迎奖金的信用卡、最大化您的支出回报以及利用信用卡优惠。
对于申请信用卡对信用评分的影响，存在很多误解。所以我想先讲一下申请信用卡对信用评分的影响（我有很多张卡，而且我的信用评分非常好），然后我会讲一下我的信用卡决策过程是怎样的，然后我会分享我目前开的卡。
关于信用评分的运作方式存在很多误解，特别是人们认为申请信用卡会损害您的信用评分。这通常是不正确的，在许多情况下，从长远来看，申请信用卡甚至可以帮助您提高信用评分。
就背景而言，我有很多信用卡，而且我的信用评分几乎是完美的，在全国排名前几位。
对于那些不熟悉的人，以下是影响您的信用评分的因素
您的分数的 35% 是您的付款历史记录（您按时付款的百分比）
分数的 30% 是您的信用利用率（您使用的信用量与总限额相比）
你的分数的 15% 是你的信用年龄（你开立账户的平均年龄）
您的分数的 10% 是您使用的信用类型（您有多少种不同类型的信用请求）
您分数的 10% 是您对新学分的请求（您申请学分的次数）
最重要的是，您按时支付账单，不要使用太多信用（这意味着您最好使用可用信用总额的 20% 或更少，和/或尽早支付信用卡账单），并长期保留一些卡，这将有助于提高您的平均账户年龄。
申请信用卡会降低的唯一指标是您对新信用的请求，但这仅占您分数的 10%。此外，信用查询通常会在 24 个月后从您的报告中消失。
关闭不再对您有用的信用卡可能也不会对您的信用造成太大损害，尽管您也可以经常降级信用卡。
申请信用卡时我要寻找什么
对我来说，申请信用卡时我会考虑三件事

title_en: Aer Lingus Completes Free Starlink Wi-Fi Rollout On Long Haul Fleet
title_zh: 爱尔兰航空在长途机队完成免费 Starlink Wi-Fi 部署
summary: Aer Lingus has installed free Starlink Wi-Fi on all 12 A330s and 14 A321s, finishing its long haul rollout well ahead of schedule. Short haul planes are next.
summary_zh: 爱尔兰航空已在所有 12 架 A330 和 14 架 A321 上安装了免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，提前完成了远程部署。短途飞机
body_en: In November 2025, International Airlines Group (IAG) announced plans to introduce free Starlink Wi-Fi across the brand’s airlines, including British Airways, Iberia, and Aer Lingus.

In March 2026, we saw Aer Lingus equip its first aircraft (an Airbus A330) with Starlink Wi-Fi. There’s now an exciting update for the airline, as all long haul planes now feature the service. That’s fantastic news for those traveling transatlantic on the airline.

Aer Lingus is partnering with SpaceX to introduce Starlink Wi-Fi throughout its fleet, including on long haul and short haul aircraft. Best of all, Aer Lingus is offering Starlink Wi-Fi for free for all passengers. With this system, it’s possible to connect with multiple devices, including laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Aer Lingus doesn’t even require you to be a member of its loyalty program in order to use the service, which is an area where IAG carriers are (generously) countering the industry trend, as other airlines are using Starlink as a way to drive loyalty program sign-ups.

Starlink is known for its high-speed, low-latency broadband internet, and the service is offered gate to gate. Starlink Wi-Fi allows for live streaming, productivity similar to on the ground (with high upload and download speeds), gaming, e-commerce, and more. Starlink is becoming increasingly popular with airlines, and we’ve seen dozens of airlines sign up for the service. As a passenger who values staying connected, I find Starlink to be a game changer .

Aer Lingus has just revealed that it has now installed Starlink Wi-Fi on all of its long haul aircraft. This includes all 12 Airbus A330s, as well as all 14 Airbus A321s (including both the A321LR and A321XLR variants). That means that all of Aer Lingus’ long haul fleet now features Starlink Wi-Fi.

The airline deserve huge credit for that rollout pace. Initially the carrier was planning on having Starlink on all long haul flights by the first quarter of 2027, then the timeline was moved forward to the end of 2026, and now the project has been wrapped up before the end of October. Kudos!
That’s the beauty of Starlink, because the actual installation process is really quick, once planes are certified to have the service.

With long haul aircraft now reconfigured, the plan is for short haul aircraft operating within Europe to get Starlink next, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. The airline has a total of 27 Airbus A320s and eight Airbus A320neos, so once that project starts, I’d expect it to only take a few months to complete, at most.

Aer Lingus is in the process of rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi, and has done an impressive job so far. At this point all long haul aircraft, including Airbus A330s, A321LRs, and A321XLRs, feature Starlink. This is well ahead of the planned timeline, which was supposed to see the project complete by the first quarter of 2027.

Next up we can expect to see short haul Aer Lingus planes get Starlink, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. Unlike non-IAG carriers, Aer Lingus isn’t requiring passengers to be a member of the loyalty program to connect to the service.
What do you make of Aer Lingus introducing free Starlink Wi-Fi?
body_zh: 2025 年 11 月，国际航空集团 (IAG) 宣布计划在该品牌旗下的航空公司（包括英国航空、西班牙国家航空和爱尔兰航空）推出免费 Starlink Wi-Fi。
2026 年 3 月，我们看到爱尔兰航空为其第一架飞机（空客 A330）配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。该航空公司现在有一个令人兴奋的更新，因为所有长途飞机现在都提供该服务。对于乘坐该航空公司跨大西洋旅行的人来说，这是个好消息。
爱尔兰航空正在与 SpaceX 合作，在其机队中引入 Starlink Wi-Fi，包括长途和短途飞机。最重要的是，爱尔兰航空为所有乘客免费提供 Starlink Wi-Fi。通过该系统，可以连接多种设备，包括笔记本电脑、平板电脑和智能手机。
爱尔兰航空甚至不要求您成为其忠诚度计划的会员即可使用该服务，而 IAG 航空公司在这一领域（慷慨地）逆袭了行业趋势，因为其他航空公司正在使用 Starlink 作为推动忠诚度计划注册的方式。
Starlink 以其高速、低延迟宽带互联网而闻名，并且该服务是门到门提供的。 Starlink Wi-Fi 可实现直播、类似于地面的生产力（具有高上传和下载速度）、游戏、电子商务等。星链越来越受到航空公司的欢迎，我们已经看到数十家航空公司注册了该服务。作为一名重视保持联系的乘客，我发现 Starlink 改变了游戏规则。
爱尔兰航空刚刚透露，目前已在其所有长途飞机上安装了 Starlink Wi-Fi。这包括所有 12 架空客 A330 以及所有 14 架空客 A321（包括 A321LR 和 A321XLR 型号）。这意味着爱尔兰航空的所有长途机队现在都配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。
该航空公司的推出速度值得高度赞扬。最初，该航空公司计划在 2027 年第一季度之前在所有长途航班上安装 Starlink，后来将时间表提前到 2026 年底，现在该项目已在 10 月底前完成。荣誉！
这就是星链的美妙之处，因为一旦飞机被认证可以提供这项服务，实际的安装过程非常快。
随着长途飞机现已重新配置，计划是让欧洲境内运营的短途飞机下一步接入星链，但具体时间表仍有待观察。该航空公司总共拥有 27 架空客 A320 和 8 架空客 A320neo，所以一旦该项目开始，我预计最多只需要几个月就能完成。
爱尔兰航空正在推出免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，迄今为止已经取得了令人印象深刻的成绩。目前，所有长途飞机，包括空客 A330、A321LR 和 A321XLR，都配备了 Starlink。这远远超出了计划时间表，该项目原定于 2027 年第一季度完成。
接下来，我们预计将看到爱尔兰航空的短途飞机接入星链，但具体时间仍有待观察。与非 IAG 航空公司不同，爱尔兰航空不要求乘客成为忠诚度计划的会员才能连接到该服务。

Atmos Summit Card welcome offer: 100,000 Atmos Rewards points plus a 25K-point Global Companion Award after spending $6,000 within the first 90 days

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , I consider Atmos Rewards points to be worth 1.5 cents each, given the great uses of these rewards . That means I value the 100,000 points at $1,500. body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017

body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. 的份额，并且由于德国、意大利和西班牙等其他欧洲战斗机伙伴国家的订单，主要零部件组件的生产正在增加。 BAE Systems 首席执行官查尔斯·伍德伯恩 (Charles Woodburn) 表示：“今天的公告延长了台风战机的生产，并保留了支撑英国国防和安全的关键主权技能。”这笔交易是英国国防工业的又一重大推动力，就在几周前，挪威在一笔价值 100 亿英镑的交易中选择了英国 26 型护卫舰。英国国防部长约翰·希利表示，该交易超出了飞机采购范围。 “这是我们两国之间不断发展的国防和工业伙伴关系的前沿，”他说。作为访问的一部分，斯塔默还参观了土耳其航空航天工业公司的设施，在那里他参观了本土的卡恩战斗机。他还接触了 Hurjet 高级喷气教练机，该教练机是英国皇家空军 (RAF) 库存中 BAE Systems Hawk 喷气教练机的潜在替代者。该协议经过了三年的谈判，其中包括在埃尔多安政府逮捕了伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊马莫格鲁后，游说德国政府要求柏林解除对欧洲战斗机销售的限制，后者被视为埃尔多安在即将举行的选举中的严重总统竞争对手。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)政府取消了制裁，部分原因是这对德国工业有利。英国和土耳其政府于 7 月就欧洲战斗机销售达成了一份谅解备忘录。土耳其对这款飞机的兴趣部分是因为在 2030 年代生产出先进版本的卡恩飞机之前，需要在过渡期间提供更强大的空战平台。与此同时，安卡拉决定选择欧洲战斗机，是因为在因购买俄罗斯防空系统而面临美国制裁以及被排除在 F-35 联合攻击战斗机计划之外后，供应来源多样化的需要。阿曼和卡塔尔飞机向土耳其的转移引发了人们对卡塔尔额外欧洲战斗机订单未来的疑问，长期以来，卡塔尔的欧洲战斗机订单一直与另外 12 架飞机的订单有关，总计 36 架。与此同时，阿曼似乎希望以洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 Block 50 为中心巩固其战斗机机队。在 BAE Systems 的 2023 年全年业绩中，该公司透露，阿曼空军已选择不为其续签支持安排。台风，目前尚不清楚该舰队现在的活跃程度。购买这些额外的飞机意味着土耳其的机队将混合三种配置。卡塔尔的飞机配备了 Mk.0 版本的有源电子扫描阵列欧洲通用雷达系统 (ECRS) 雷达，而阿曼的飞机配备了机械扫描 Captor 传感器。除了欧洲战斗机订单外，埃尔多安和斯塔默还透露，他们正在制定一项新的贸易和安全协议。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 文章类型 文章 主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者托尼·奥斯本 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 从列表中排除？没有标签： 土耳其 、 欧洲战斗机台风 、 BAE 系统 、 MBDA 门控 ASD 特色图片 Typhoon_1600px.jpg title_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机“莲花计划”揭晓
summary: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototy
summary_zh: 莲花计划，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机揭晓 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. body_en: EHang VT35 william.moore@… Tue, 07/29/2025 - 08:58 The VT35 is an autonomous lift-plus-cruise eVTOL being developed by EHang. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. It features eight distributed lift propellers on tandem wings for vertical takeoff and landing—four facing upward and four downward—and an aft-mounted pusher prop for cruise flight. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. title_en: The Best Frequent Flyer Programs For Redeeming Miles: My 8 Top Picks
title_zh: 兑换里程的最佳飞行常客计划：我的 8 个首选
summary: If I could only redeem miles through eight frequent flyer programs, which would I pick? Here are my favorites, roughly ranked, and why each one earns a spot.
summary_zh: 如果我只能通过八个常旅客计划兑换里程，我会选择哪个？以下是我最喜欢的，大致排名，以及为什么每个人都能赚钱
body_en: In this post, I’d like to share an updated list of what I consider to be the most useful frequent flyer programs for redeeming miles, as my picks have changed a bit. Essentially, if you could only ever redeem miles through a limited number of frequent flyer programs again, which would they be? I’m curious to hear how OMAAT community members feel…

Admittedly this question is entirely theoretical. For those of us in the United States with access to credit cards, the reality is that you never really have to commit to just several frequent flyer programs, as the major transferable points currencies give you access to dozens of partners. That kind of flexibility is invaluable. Furthermore, lots of loyalty programs sell miles at a discount , in a way where it can make sense to outright purchase miles and then immediately redeem.

But still, if you had to commit yourself to only redeeming points through a limited number of airline frequent flyer programs, how would you go about picking them? Essentially I’d try to find the programs that offer the best balance between good redemption rates, a lot of airlines and routes you can potentially redeem on, access to as much award availability as possible, and an easy booking process.

Furthermore, I’d want to consider which routes I frequently fly and want to redeem on, rather than just the general value of a program. However, I wouldn’t base my choice on whether a program has a particular sweet spot , but rather would base it on the overall value and flexibility offered.

Admittedly a major issue with making a choice is acknowledging that programs change over time. I’m not sure I’d want to be locked into any program for a lifetime, so I’m basing my choices on the current realities of redemption options.

I think the other major issue is that we’re increasingly seeing discrepancies in award availability between airlines . In other words, many airlines don’t make most of their award space available to partner programs, and that makes it really hard to commit to any programs. We’re increasingly getting to the point where if you want to redeem for premium cabin travel on a particular airline, you often have to actually collect miles with that program.
The frequent flyer programs I find to be most valuable

With the above out of the way, let me share what I’d currently consider to be the most valuable programs for award redemption opportunities. If I could only redeem through these eight programs again, I actually wouldn’t feel like I’m losing out that much (at least based on current conditions).

With that in mind, below are my picks, roughly in order, starting with my favorite. If you wanted to make this a list of the top five programs for redeeming miles (as I see it), then just ignore the last three programs on the list. Separately, also consider airline points expiration policies , and award ticket change and cancelation fees .

I consider Air Canada Aeroplan to be one of the most useful frequent flyer programs . Aeroplan has reasonable redemption rates , an amazing array of airline partners , and allows stopovers for 5,000 points . Simply put, I think Aeroplan leaves one best positioned for aspirational redemptions. On top of that, there are no fuel surcharges through Aeroplan.
I book a ton of awards through Aeroplan, ranging from “simple” long haul business class awards , to more complicated round the world journeys with stopovers .

Unfortunately the biggest challenge for the value of Aeroplan points is airlines increasingly limiting award space to members of their own programs, which makes it tough to build complex awards. For that matter, Lufthansa first class awards no longer being bookable with partner points is perhaps the biggest loss to the value of Aeroplan points, since that was my most frequent redemptions with Aeroplan.

Air France-KLM Flying Blue is the most useful SkyTeam frequent flyer program , in my opinion. A lot of us like to fly across the Atlantic, and Flying Blue has access to more Air France and KLM business class award space than partner programs.

Air France and KLM release a fair amount of saver level business class award space on long haul flights. Even better is that Flying Blue Platinum members and above receive access to more award space , so there’s lots of value to having that status. This is my most common way of redeeming to Europe, and I also love how the program allows free stopovers , even on one-way awards.

Flying Blue transatlantic business class awards start at 60,000 miles one-way. While these are nowadays “Light” fares that don’t offer flexibility , you’ll otherwise pay 75,000 miles for the added flexibility. Alternatively, Flying Blue Platinum members can still book “Light” fares with fewer restrictions.

Flying Blue also in many cases has attractive award pricing on partner airlines, so it’s also a program I use for SkyTeam partner redemptions. It’s also important to keep in mind the frequency with which Flying Blue has transfer bonuses from other currencies.
American AAdvantage continues to be the best frequent flyer program of the “big three” US carriers, in my opinion.

The reality is that AAdvantage has excellent partner redemption rates , especially on Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways . These are among the most useful for traveling to the Middle East, India, Africa, Central Asia, etc., and AAdvantage miles leave you best positioned for those redemptions. While many of those awards are now restricted on routes to and from the United States, availability is still quite good between other regions.

I also find that AAdvantage often has good redemption rates on its own metal, including for first and business class travel on long haul flights, which can be practical, though not particularly aspirational. The same is true for domestic flights, where pricing in all cabins tends to be the most attractive of the “big three” programs. I appreciate how AAdvantage has no change and cancelation fees , so you can speculatively lock in itineraries that work best for you.

The Alaska Atmos Rewards program has evolved a lot over the years, both for better and worse. Nowadays Atmos Rewards has a zone and distance based award chart , which is particularly lucrative for short haul awards.
body_zh: 在这篇文章中，我想分享一份我认为最有用的常旅客兑换里程计划的更新列表，因为我的选择发生了一些变化。从本质上讲，如果您只能通过有限数量的飞行常客计划再次兑换里程，您会选择哪些？我很好奇 OMAAT 社区成员的感受……
诚然，这个问题完全是理论上的。对于我们这些在美国可以使用信用卡的人来说，现实是您永远不必真正致力于几个常旅客计划，因为主要的可转让积分货币可以让您接触到数十个合作伙伴。这种灵活性是无价的。此外，许多忠诚度计划都以折扣价出售里程，这样直接购买里程然后立即兑换就很有意义。
但是，如果您必须承诺仅通过有限数量的航空公司常旅客计划兑换积分，您会如何选择它们？本质上，我会尝试找到能够在良好的兑换率、大量可以兑换的航空公司和航线、获得尽可能多的奖励以及简单的预订流程之间提供最佳平衡的计划。
此外，我想考虑我经常飞行并想要兑换的航线，而不仅仅是计划的一般价值。然而，我的选择不会基于程序是否具有特定的最佳点，而是基于所提供的整体价值和灵活性。
诚然，做出选择的一个主要问题是承认项目会随着时间的推移而变化。我不确定我是否愿意终生被锁定在任何计划中，所以我的选择基于当前兑换选项的现实。
我认为另一个主要问题是我们越来越多地看到航空公司之间的奖励差异。换句话说，许多航空公司并没有将大部分奖励空间提供给合作伙伴计划，这使得承诺任何计划都变得非常困难。我们越来越意识到，如果您想兑换特定航空公司的高级客舱旅行，您通常必须通过该计划实际累积里程。
我认为最有价值的飞行常客计划
抛开上述内容，让我分享一下我目前认为最有价值的奖励兑换机会计划。如果我只能再次通过这八个项目来赎回，我实际上不会觉得自己损失了那么多（至少根据目前的情况）。
考虑到这一点，以下是我的选择，大致按顺序排列，从我最喜欢的开始。如果您想将其作为兑换里程的前五个计划的列表（如我所见），那么只需忽略列表中的最后三个计划即可。另外，还要考虑航空公司积分过期政策以及奖励机票变更和取消费用。
我认为加拿大航空 Aeroplan 是最有用的飞行常客计划之一。 Aeroplan 拥有合理的兑换率、众多的航空公司合作伙伴，并允许中途停留 5,000 点积分。简而言之，我认为 Aeroplan 为理想的兑换留下了最佳位置。最重要的是，Aeroplan 不收取燃油附加费。
我通过 Aeroplan 预订了大量奖励，从“简单”的长途商务舱奖励，到更复杂的中途停留的环球旅行。
不幸的是，Aeroplan 积分价值面临的最大挑战是航空公司越来越多地限制其自身计划成员的奖励空间，这使得建立复杂的奖励变得困难。就此而言，汉莎航空头等舱奖励不再可以使用合作伙伴积分预订可能是 Aeroplan 积分价值的最大损失，因为这是我最常使用 Aeroplan 兑换的。
在我看来，法航-荷航蓝天飞行是最有用的天合联盟常旅客计划。我们很多人都喜欢飞越大西洋，与合作伙伴计划相比，蓝天飞行能够获得更多法航和荷航商务舱奖励空间。
法航和荷航在长途航班上释放了大量的经济舱商务舱奖励空间。更好的是，蓝天飞行白金卡会员及以上会员可以获得更多奖励空间，因此拥有该身份具有很大的价值。这是我兑换欧洲机票最常用的方式，而且我也很喜欢该计划允许免费中途停留的方式，即使是单程奖励也是如此。
蓝天飞行跨大西洋商务舱奖励起价为单程 60,000 英里。虽然这些现在是不提供灵活性的“轻量”票价，但您将需要为增加的灵活性支付 75,000 英里。另外，蓝天飞行白金卡会员仍然可以预订限制较少的“Light”票价。
在很多情况下，蓝天飞行还为合作伙伴航空公司提供具有吸引力的奖励定价，因此这也是我用于天合联盟合作伙伴兑换的一个计划。同样重要的是要记住蓝天飞行从其他货币转移奖金的频率。
在我看来，美国 AAdvantage 仍然是美国“三大”航空公司中最好的常旅客计划。
事实上，AAdvantage 拥有出色的合作伙伴兑换率，尤其是阿提哈德航空和卡塔尔航空。这些对于前往中东、印度、非洲、中亚等地旅行最有用，AAdvantage 里程可以让您为这些兑换做好准备。虽然其中许多奖励现在仅限于往返美国的航线，但其他地区之间的可用性仍然相当不错。
我还发现，AAdvantage 通常对自己的金属有很高的兑换率，包括长途航班的头等舱和商务舱旅行，这可能很实用，但不是特别理想。国内航班也是如此，所有舱位的定价往往是“三大”计划中最具吸引力的。我很欣赏 AAdvantage 不收取变更费和取消费，因此您可以推测性地锁定最适合您的行程。
多年来，阿拉斯加 Atmos 奖励计划已经发生了很大的变化，无论好坏。如今，Atmos Rewards 拥有基于区域和距离的奖励图表，这对于短途奖励来说尤其有利可图。

body_en: Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045 - Aviation24.be
Home Manufacturers Airbus Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045

Airbus expects the worldwide dedicated freighter fleet to grow from 2,360 aircraft in 2026 to 3,460 by 2045, an increase of approximately 46%, driven by fleet replacement and expanding air cargo demand.

Its 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast, presented at the Cargo Facts Symposium, estimates a requirement for 2,670 freighter deliveries over the period. Replacements will account for 1,580 aircraft, with a further 1,090 supporting growth.

Passenger-to-freighter conversions are expected to supply 1,700 aircraft, compared with 970 new-build freighters. By size, demand comprises 1,140 single-aisle aircraft, 860 medium widebodies and 670 large widebodies.

North America will lead demand with 925 deliveries, followed by Asia-Pacific with 850. Together, the regions represent approximately two-thirds of the total. Europe and the CIS will require 515 aircraft, Latin America 165, the Middle East 125 and Africa 90.

Airbus forecasts annual air cargo traffic growth of 3.2% over the next two decades, outpacing projected global trade growth of 2.9%. It identifies e-commerce, high-value technology shipments and the use of air freight as an alternative to maritime transport among the principal drivers.

Asia-Pacific is expected to remain the leading region for international air cargo traffic, with North American connections forming the largest market. Airbus sees opportunities for its A350F and passenger-to-freighter conversions across the A320, A321 and A330 families as operators replace older aircraft.

在货运事实研讨会上发布的《2026 年货运全球市场预测》估计，在此期间需要交付 2,670 架货机。替换飞机将占 1,580 架，另有 1,090 架飞机用于支持增长。
客机改装预计将供应 1,700 架飞机，而新建货机则为 970 架。按规模划分，需求包括 1,140 架单通道飞机、860 架中型宽体飞机和 670 架大型宽体飞机。
北美地区将交付 925 架飞机，引领需求，其次是亚太地区，交付 850 架飞机。这些地区合计约占总数的三分之二。欧洲和独联体将需要 515 架飞机，拉丁美洲 165 架，中东 125 架，非洲 90 架。
空中客车公司预测，未来二十年航空货运量年增长率为 3.2%，超过预计的全球贸易增长率 2.9%。它将电子商务、高价值技术运输和使用空运作为海运替代品列为主要驱动力。
预计亚太地区仍将是国际航空货运量的领先地区，其中北美航线将成为最大的市场。随着运营商更换旧飞机，空中客车公司看到了 A350F 以及 A320、A321 和 A330 系列客机改装的机会。

title_en: American posts record revenue but fuel costs drive third-quarter loss
title_zh: 美国航空营收创历史新高，但燃料成本导致第三季度亏损
summary: American Airlines reported record third-quarter revenue of US$16.3 billion, up 19.3% year-on-year, but higher fuel costs pushed the group to a net loss of US$269 million. The airline’s fuel bill increased by US$1.9 billion, or 67.5%, compared with the third qu
summary_zh: 美国航空公布第三季度收入创纪录，达163亿美元，同比增长19.3%，但燃油成本上涨导致该集团出现净亏损
body_en: American posts record revenue but fuel costs drive third-quarter loss - Aviation24.be
American Airlines reported record third-quarter revenue of US$16.3 billion, up 19.3% year-on-year, but higher fuel costs pushed the group to a net loss of US$269 million.

The airline’s fuel bill increased by US$1.9 billion, or 67.5%, compared with the third quarter of 2025. Its adjusted net loss was US$182 million, while unit costs excluding fuel and special items rose by 3%.

Revenue growth extended across cabins and markets. Premium revenue increased by 22.9% and Main Cabin revenue by 19.5%, while total revenue per available seat kilometre rose by 14.5%. International passenger unit revenue grew by 16.4%, led by Latin America, ahead of a 13.6% increase domestically.

Business travel also remained strong, with managed corporate revenue rising by 27.6%, its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Enrolments in the AAdvantage loyalty programme increased by 27.4%.

American is continuing investment in premium seating, lounges and onboard technology. It plans to extend Starlink connectivity across its entire mainline fleet of more than 1,000 aircraft and introduce seatback entertainment on new narrowbody deliveries from 2028. A narrowbody retrofit programme is intended to raise premium seating to 40% of seats in the coming years.
The group ended September with US$11.8 billion in available liquidity. It expects its efficiency programme to deliver nearly US$1 billion in annualised savings by the end of 2026.

For the fourth quarter, American forecasts revenue growth of 19.5–22.5%, but anticipates a further US$2.8 billion year-on-year increase in fuel expense, based on the forward fuel curve as of 19 October. Elevated fuel prices are also expected to slow network growth in 2027 compared with 2026.

美国航空公布第三季度营收创历史新高，达163亿美元，同比增长19.3%，但燃油成本上涨导致该集团净亏损2.69亿美元。
与 2025 年第三季度相比，该航空公司的燃油费用增加了 19 亿美元，即 67.5%。调整后的净亏损为 1.82 亿美元，不包括燃油和特殊项目的单位成本增长了 3%。
收入增长遍及各个客舱和市场。高级舱收入增长了 22.9%，经济舱收入增长了 19.5%，而每可用座公里的总收入增长了 14.5%。国际客运单位收入增长 16.4%，其中拉丁美洲领先，国内客运收入增长 13.6%。
商务旅行也保持强劲，托管企业收入增长 27.6%，连续第六个季度实现两位数增长。 AAdvantage 忠诚度计划的注册人数增加了 27.4%。
美国航空持续投资于高级座椅、休息室和机上技术。该公司计划将 Starlink 连接扩展到其超过 1,000 架飞机的整个干线机队，并从 2028 年开始在新交付的窄体飞机上引入座椅靠背娱乐系统。窄体飞机改装计划旨在在未来几年将高级座椅比例提高到 40%。
截至 9 月底，该集团的可用流动资金为 118 亿美元。预计到 2026 年底，其效率计划将每年节省近 10 亿美元。
美国航空预计第四季度收入增长 19.5-22.5%，但根据截至 10 月 19 日的远期燃油曲线，预计燃油费用同比将进一步增加 28 亿美元。与 2026 年相比，燃料价格上涨预计也会导致 2027 年网络增长放缓。
